verdict.rationale: Fireflies can filter/search past transcripts by attendee email (fireflies-docs-29) and AskFred lets users ask natural-language questions across meeting history (fireflies-docs-39), which could be manually used to reconstruct a per-person meeting history, but there is no documented feature that automatically surfaces past meetings with the same attendees or generates an open-threads brief before an upcoming call. missing for 10: automated pre-meeting brief/prep feature, proactive surfacing tied to calendar events, evidence of 'open threads' summarization across meetings.
